title: Video-as-Weights: Compiling a Video Once into Parametric and Token Memory
title_zh: Video-as-Weights：将视频一次性编译为参数记忆与词元记忆
abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) represent videos as thousands of visual tokens, creating a large key-value cache whose memory grows with video length. At the same time, small VLMs that fit on limited hardware understand video far worse than large models. Existing compression methods shorten visual tokens into a brief prompt to save memory, yet the small model still processes them through fixed weights and cannot close this capability gap. To address both challenges, we introduce Video-as-Weights (VaW), which compiles a video once without seeing any question into the parametric and token memory of a frozen interpreter VLM. Specifically, a compiler VLM watches the video, and a single weight decoder jointly generates the interpreter's LoRA weights and optional prefix tokens from every compiler layer, enabling both same-model compilation and strong-to-weak transfer across model sizes and depths. Across six video QA benchmarks, a 0.8B interpreter beats full in-context reading by 1.7 points when compiled by itself and by 4.3 points with a 9B compiler, reducing context from up to 8,192 visual tokens to 64 prefix tokens while using 5.5x less memory than the video's key-value cache. Generated weights add 3.9 points over token compression alone, and all-layer decoding outperforms layer-wise generation by 2.9 points. Mechanistic analysis shows that with prefix tokens, the weights mainly alter attention queries and MLP down projections to guide retrieval and store a baseline summary, whereas without tokens, they shift to attention output projections to write video content directly into the residual stream.
abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）通常将视频表示为数千个视觉词元，导致键值缓存（KV cache）随视频长度增长。现有压缩方法虽能缩短上下文，却无法弥补小模型在视频理解上的能力差距。Video-as-Weights（VaW）无需预先知道问题，就能将视频一次性编译为冻结解释器 VLM 的 LoRA 权重和可选的前缀词元，供后续问答复用。编译器 VLM 观看视频后，由同一个解码器汇集其所有层的表征，联合生成权重和前缀词元，既支持同模型编译，也支持跨模型规模和深度的强到弱迁移。在六个视频问答基准上，0.8B 解释器相较于自行读取完整视频上下文，自编译时提高 1.7 分，使用 9B 编译器时提高 4.3 分。视频上下文从最多 8,192 个视觉词元压缩至 64 个前缀词元，所需内存约为原视频 KV cache 的 1/5.5。机制分析发现，LoRA 权重在有前缀时主要辅助检索并存储视频概要，在无前缀时则更直接地写入视频内容。
key_points_zh: VaW 在看到问题之前，就将视频编译为冻结解释器的 LoRA 权重与可选前缀词元，同一份记忆可用于回答多个问题。
在六个视频问答基准上，0.8B 解释器相较于读取完整视频上下文，自编译提高 1.7 分，由 9B 编译器编译则提高 4.3 分。
最多 8,192 个视觉词元压缩为 64 个前缀词元，内存占用约为原视频 KV cache 的 1/5.5。
生成 LoRA 权重比仅压缩词元多提升 3.9 分；汇集所有层表征进行解码比逐层生成高 2.9 分。
有前缀时，生成权重主要调整注意力查询投影和 MLP 下投影，以引导检索并存储概要；无前缀时，则更多通过注意力输出投影将视频内容直接写入残差流。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是将视频一次编译为可供后续多次问答复用的 LoRA 权重与前缀记忆，而非仅压缩视觉输入。六项视频问答基准及通道移除、跨视频替换消融验证了两类记忆的作用；前缀预算与 LoRA 秩实验量化了准确率和存储取舍。证据限于同一模型家族的离线视频问答，未验证音频或在线交互。
